aliases: PLA Navy Bengbu Petty Officer Academy

evidence.summary: CASI describes the Naval NCO School in Bengbu as the PLA Navy’s school for non-commissioned officers. It grew from a naval aviation school founded in 1961, became the Naval Bengbu Sergeant School in 1986 (one of the PLA’s first two NCO schools and the first for navy NCOs) and took its present name in the 2017 reforms; it teaches navigation, electromechanical, communications, electronics, weapons and management majors, with weapons and electromechanical training facilities and a light-weapons range.
The school reports to PLA Navy headquarters.

sources.title: The People’s Liberation Army’s 37 Academic Institutions (2020), pp. 145–146
